title: Heavy Construction Equipment
shortSummary: GulfFast provides certified heavy construction equipment rental across Saudi Arabia, supplying excavators, bulldozers, wheel loaders, and graders directly from our Al Khobar operations hub to major oil, gas, and infrastructure sites. All machinery is maintained to Aramco, SABIC, and SEC safety specifications with optional certified operators.
description:
GulfFast Rentals delivers fleet-ready heavy earthmoving and construction equipment to contractor job sites throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Founded as part of GulfFast Trading (est. 1999 in Al Khobar), our heavy equipment division serves main contractors across the Eastern Province, Dammam, Jubail, Riyadh, and mega-projects like NEOM and the Red Sea Development.

Our heavy machinery fleet includes high-tonnage excavators (Caterpillar, Komatsu), D8/D10 heavy dozers, articulated motor graders, and wheel loaders tested for extreme ambient temperatures and desert conditions. Every piece of equipment undergoes rigorous Third-Party Inspection (TPI) and comes with complete maintenance history records, daily pre-op checklists, and site-ready safety features required for Aramco gas plants and SABIC petrochemical complexes.

Whether your project demands long-term monthly rental contracts for site preparation or rapid short-term mobilization for emergency civil works, GulfFast offers direct-supplier reliability without middleman markup. We provide options for bare-rentals as well as fully operated and maintained (O&M) packages with Aramco-certified heavy equipment operators.

faq.question: Does GulfFast provide Aramco-certified heavy equipment operators?
faq.answer: Yes. GulfFast supplies both bare equipment rentals and fully operated rentals with Aramco-certified, SAG-licensed heavy equipment operators holding valid Third-Party Inspection (TPI) cards.

faq.question: What is the typical mobilization time for heavy equipment in Jubail or Dammam?
faq.answer: Standard mobilization for available heavy equipment within the Eastern Province (Al Khobar, Dammam, Jubail, Ras Tanura) is 24 to 48 hours following contract execution and gate pass approval.

faq.question: Are all heavy machines inspected for Aramco and SABIC site access?
faq.answer: All GulfFast rental machinery undergoes stringent TPI certification and meets Saudi Aramco Safety Handbook guidelines, including spark arrestors, fire suppression, reverse alarms, and beacon lights.

title: Industrial Generators & Power Systems
shortSummary: GulfFast supplies heavy-duty diesel generator rental solutions from 20 kVA to 1500 kVA across Saudi Arabia, backing critical oilfield, construction, and plant shutdown power needs. Headquartered in Al Khobar, we offer full power packages including fuel tanks, distribution panels, step-up transformers, and 24/7 technical support.
description:
When main grid power is unavailable or site uptime is non-negotiable, GulfFast Industrial Power Rentals provides dependable diesel generator rental units engineered for harsh Middle Eastern climates. Serving oilfield drill sites, remote pipeline corridors, infrastructure camps, and commercial construction projects throughout KSA, our power generation fleet is backed by over two decades of GulfFast industrial supply excellence.

Our inventory consists of low-decibel, sound-attenuated diesel generators manufactured by industry leaders such as Cummins, Perkins, Caterpillar, and Denyo. Units range from compact 20 kVA mobile towable sets for site offices up to multi-megawatt synchronized power modules designed for refinery shutdowns and heavy industrial processing facilities.

Each generator rental package includes external dual-wall fuel storage tanks, heavy-duty armored power cables, automatic transfer switches (ATS), load banks for pre-commissioning testing, and step-up/step-down transformers. GulfFast power technicians handle delivery, cabling, site installation, fuel management, and round-the-clock maintenance to ensure zero uninterrupted downtime for your operations.

title: Mobile Cranes & Lifting Equipment
shortSummary: GulfFast supplies mobile cranes, rough-terrain cranes, crawler cranes, and telescopic handlers for heavy lifting operations across Saudi Arabia. Based in Al Khobar, our certified crane fleet is supported by Saudi Aramco certified riggers and crane operators for safe industrial erection and plant maintenance.
description:
GulfFast Mobile Crane & Lifting Rentals provides certified heavy-lift machinery and rigging support to construction sites, petrochemical plants, steel fabricators, and logistics terminals across Saudi Arabia. From quick 25-ton pick-and-carry tasks to complex 500-ton multi-crane industrial lifts, our fleet delivers maximum structural reach and load capacity.

Our lifting inventory includes rough-terrain cranes (Liebherr, Tadano, Kato), all-terrain hydraulic cranes, crawler cranes for soft-soil pipeline jobs, and heavy-duty telehandlers (JCB, Manitou). All lifting equipment undergoes periodic Third-Party Inspection (TPI) by authorized certification bodies in Saudi Arabia, ensuring full compliance with Saudi Aramco GI 7.027 and SAG safety directives.

In addition to bare crane rentals, GulfFast provides complete lifting packages comprising TUV-certified riggers (Level 1, 2, and 3), certified crane operators, lift plan engineering support, and certified rigging tackle (shackles, wire rope slings, spreader bars, web slings).

title: Air Compressors & Pneumatic Tools

Headquartered in Al Khobar, our compressor fleet features Atlas Copco, Ingersoll Rand, and Doosan units.
description:
For high-reliability compressed air in demanding industrial environments, GulfFast provides air compressor rental services engineered for Saudi Arabia's extreme temperatures and dust conditions. Supporting abrasive sandblasting contractors, pipeline testing crews, utility maintenance teams, and refinery turnaround operations, our compressor fleet covers high-volume CFM and ultra-high PSI requirements.

Our inventory ranges from 185 CFM towable rotary screw air compressors for pneumatic break-outs up to 1600 CFM high-pressure diesel compressors (up to 350 PSI) for pipeline drying, hydrotesting backup, and deep-well blowout prevention. We also offer 100% oil-free Class 0 air compressors for sensitive food processing, pharmaceutical, and instrument air systems.

All compressor rentals come complete with heavy-duty air hoses, moisture separators, aftercoolers, air receivers, and pneumatic accessories including jackhammers, rock drills, sandblasting pots, and pneumatic impact wrenches.

title: Industrial Welding Machines
shortSummary: GulfFast supplies multi-process diesel welder generators and electric welding machine rentals across Saudi Arabia for cross-country pipelines, plant shutdowns, and structural fabrication. Based in Al Khobar, our fleet features Miller, Lincoln Electric, and Denyo welding machines.
description:
Precision welding integrity requires stable arc performance and rugged, site-tested power source units. GulfFast Industrial Welding Rentals provides heavy-duty diesel welding generators and multi-process electric welding power sources designed for rigorous pipeline welding, tank erection, and plant maintenance across KSA.

Our welding inventory features 400 Amp to 600 Amp single-operator and dual-operator diesel welder generators (Lincoln Vantage, Miller Big Blue, Denyo), capable of SMAW (Stick), GTAW (TIG), GMAW (MIG), and FCAW (Flux-Cored) welding processes. Units are enclosed in heavy steel roll cages with lifting eyes, spark arrestors, and auxiliary 110V/220V power outlets to operate grinding tools and line-up clamps simultaneously.

We also supply specialized multi-station welding banks (6-pack and 8-pack welding racks) for high-density structural and piping projects, complete with welding leads, ground clamps, electrode holders, and calibrated TPI certificates.

Continuous round-the-clock site operations in Saudi Arabia demand safe, intense, and fuel-efficient illumination. GulfFast Mobile Lighting Rentals supplies heavy-duty diesel and solar-powered light towers tailored for night shifts, road paving, oilfield operations, and remote site security across the Kingdom.

Our light tower fleet features vertical telescopic masts extending up to 9 meters with 360-degree rotation, fitted with 4x1000W Metal Halide or high-efficiency 4x350W LED floodlights delivering over 440,000 lumens. Powered by ultra-quiet Kubota or Perkins diesel engines with 110-liter long-run fuel tanks, these units run continuously for up to 60-70 hours per fill.

Designed for extreme desert conditions, GulfFast light towers feature heavy-duty outriggers tested for 80 km/h wind resistance, automatic dusk-to-dawn sensors, and towable road-legal trailers for effortless relocation between site zones.

High groundwater tables along coastal Eastern Province sites and heavy flash flood runoff require high-capacity, non-clogging pumping solutions. GulfFast Dewatering & Industrial Pump Rentals provides heavy-duty diesel and electric pump packages designed for continuous water management across Saudi Arabia.

Our pumping inventory covers 4-inch to 12-inch fully automatic prime-assisted centrifugal pumps (Godwin, Flygt, Sykes), heavy solids-handling trash pumps capable of passing up to 3-inch solids, and high-head multistage booster pumps for pipeline hydrotesting. All diesel units are housed in sound-attenuated acoustic canopies with high-efficiency diesel engines.

GulfFast provides complete dewatering packages including suction/discharge layflat hoses, HD-PE piping headers, quick-connect Bauer couplings, check valves, wellpoint dewatering rings, and on-site pump operators.
